title: trailer like pack
description: this modpack makes minecraft look like in the trailers and adds new animations
body:
This modpack transforms Minecraft to look much closer to the official trailers and promotional videos. It upgrades the visual style of the game with improved textures, smoother animations, and detailed 3D models that make the world feel more alive and immersive. Many blocks and items receive 3D textures, giving them real depth instead of flat surfaces, while mobs and player actions have enhanced animations that look more natural and dynamic.

The modpack also focuses on keeping the original Minecraft style while polishing it, so it still feels like vanilla Minecraft but with higher quality visuals. Lighting, particles, and environmental details are improved to make forests, caves, and villages look more cinematic. Small visual tweaks, such as better item models and improved movement animations, help the game resemble the vibrant and polished look often seen in Minecraft trailers and showcases.
